description: Replication Data for: Structural health monitoring of jacket-type support structures in offshore wind turbines: a comprehensive dataset for bolt loosening detection through vibrational analysis is a data set deposited in CORA.Repositori de Dades de Recerca by its authors Rhandall Valdez Yepez, Christian Tutivén (Escuela Superior Politecnica del Litoral). This dataset is a collection of vibrational data for structural health monitoring, with focus on the detection of bolt loosening in offshore wind turbine jacket foundations. The data set comprises 780 comma-separated values (CSV) files, each corresponding to specific experimental conditions, including various structural states of the wind turbine's support structure. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. Formats: CSV. Size stated: 12845056. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
